lead_deck: Land and air intervention in the forest fire in Kalkan Üzümlü, Kaş
lead_body: Intensive intervention from land and air is ongoing against the forest fire that occurred in Kalkan Üzümlü, Kaş. The teams fighting the fire are working to prevent its spread. Residents of Kalkan and Kaş, as well as holidaymakers, are closely following the fire-fighting efforts.
